notes_list.title: Product Prediction
notes_list.basic_overview: The most common advanced questions provide a substrate and reagents and ask for the major product.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
Solve in this order: identify reactive functional group → classify reagent as nucleophile/electrophile/oxidant/reductant/base → identify mechanism → check regioselectivity → check stereochemistry → check rearrangement possibility → draw product.

MECHANISM & STEPWISE EXPLANATION
The source describes the transformation as: The most common advanced questions provide a substrate and reagents and ask for the major product. The mechanism should be read as activation of the stated substrate, formation of the key reactive intermediate, the bond-making/bond-breaking event described by the reaction, and the stated work-up/product-forming step.

1. Activate the stated substrate with the listed reagent/conditions.
2. Generate the key reactive intermediate or electrophile/nucleophile implied by the reaction.
3. Carry out the characteristic bond-forming, bond-breaking or rearrangement step.
4. Complete proton transfer/work-up and verify the characteristic product.
